spec.kitLine: Damage dealt to Shield ▲ 100.09% for 3 sec
spec.scope: Damage against enemy SHIELDS only — not a generic damage buff; the scope-lock boss is partless and carries no shield mechanic, and no StatKey exists for shield-damage
spec.durationSemantics: durationSec: 3 (wall-clock seconds, refreshed per full-charge landing)
spec.triggerIdentity: shotFired by the owner landing a Full Charge attack (SR, chargeFrames 60 — every fully-charged pull qualifies); on-hit, not on-cast
spec.nearestWrongModel: Encoding it as a generic attackDamagePct or damageTakenPct buff because 'Damage ▲' pattern-matches a damage buff — over-credits the whole team ~100% with near-full uptime (3s refresh on a ~1s SR cadence)
spec.distinguishingAssertion: totals() with the override as-shipped vs withPatchedOverride(mari, o => strip this line) are IDENTICAL for every slug; no buffApply with value 100.09 ever appears in the event log
spec.inertness: Must move ZERO damage for every unit in every comp; the verbatim text must sit in unmodeled.skill1

spec.scope: pierceDamagePct — feeds the Damage-Up bucket ONLY for pierce-tagged attacks (an ally is affected only while pierce-tagged: mari inside her own skill2 gainPierce window, or a hasPierce/pierceModes carrier); NOT generic attack damage
spec.durationSemantics: durationSec: 10, refreshed on each qualifying core landing
spec.triggerIdentity: shotFired by the OWNER with requiresCore gate ('Activates when landing an attack on a target's core' — mari's own core hits, on-hit); NOT any-ally core hits, NOT ungated
spec.targetSet: allies (all allies incl. self); same-caster-slot overwrite on refresh
spec.nearestWrongModel: Two candidates, both plausible: (a) dropping requiresCore so every shot procs it (over-credits uptime whenever core exposure dips); (b) encoding as attackDamagePct because pierceDamagePct's schema comment says 'inert in v1' — the gainPierce comment supersedes that (Pierce Damage ▲ goes live for pierce-tagged attackers), so re-bucketing to attackDamagePct over-credits every NON-pierce hit on the team
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Every buffApply {stat:'pierceDamagePct', value:40.99} is emitted only on frames where a mari-srcSlot damage event with core landed (count(buffApply) ≤ count(mari core-landing shots)); AND a non-pierce ally's per-unit total is IDENTICAL with this line stripped via withPatchedOverride while mari's own total (pierce-tagged in her skill2 windows) moves — red under both the ungated and the attackDamagePct misreads
spec.inertness: Must not move any ally that is never pierce-tagged; must not buff mari's own shots outside her gainPierce windows

spec.scope: Self attacks become Pierce-tagged (activates own + teammates' Pierce Damage ▲ for her hits) — a timed window, not a whole-fight property
spec.durationSemantics: gainPierce effect with durationSec: 5 — a TIMED window per activation; NOT the top-level hasPierce:true boolean (whole-fight)
spec.triggerIdentity: interval — the ■ header has NO 'Activates when' clause, so per the no-activation-clause convention this rides the unit's datamined skill CD; first fire t=CD (no force-cast language). ⚑ the interval seconds: NOT in the kit prose, must come from datamined skillCooldownsSec — flag with the datamined value, never guess
spec.nearestWrongModel: hasPierce: true at the file top level — whole-fight pierce tagging. This makes skill1's Pierce Damage ▲ 40.99% live 100% of the fight instead of ~5s/CD, a large systematic over-credit; second-nearest: keying the trigger to burstCast/fullBurstEnter instead of interval
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Before the first interval fire (t < CD) mari's damage events carry NO pierce eligibility: a co-active pierceDamagePct buff does not raise her early-magazine damage vs the buff stripped (compare totals over the pre-CD prefix conceptually via event mults); green when pierce turns on only at t=CD in 5s windows, red when hasPierce makes shot 1 already pierce-boosted
spec.inertness: Between windows (CD gap minus 5s) her shots must NOT be pierce-tagged; no other unit's pierce state moves

spec.scope: Generic ATK buff scaling mari's OWN ATK (atkPct) — applies to all her damage, no attack-type scoping
spec.durationSemantics: durationSec: 5, same block as the pierce grant, refreshed each interval fire
spec.triggerIdentity: interval, same CD/first-fire as the Gain Pierce line (shared ■ block) — ⚑ datamined CD
spec.nearestWrongModel: Merging it with the ally line into one allies-targeted block, losing the self/ally stat distinction — or giving the self line casterAtkPct (numerically identical for self, but then the same-slot overwrite vs the ally block's casterAtkPct key silently drops one of the two stacks
spec.distinguishingAssertion: buffApply {stat:'atkPct', value:30.78, targetSlug:'mari'} appears at each interval fire ALONGSIDE the ally-block casterAtkPct apply on mari (two distinct stat keys on her simultaneously); red if only one of the two lands on her
spec.inertness: The atkPct 30.78 stat must never appear on any non-mari target

spec.kitLine: ATK ▲ 30.78% of the skill user's ATK (allies)
spec.scope: casterAtkPct — a FLAT ATK add equal to 30.78% of MARI's ATK, not a % of each ally's own ATK. Mari is a Supporter (static 98,367 at scope lock), so encoding as atkPct over-credits every Attacker (118,027 base) by ~20%
spec.triggerIdentity: interval, same shared skill2 CD — ⚑ datamined
spec.targetSet: allies (all allies incl. self — self legitimately holds BOTH this flat add and the atkPct self buff; they are different stat keys and stack)
spec.nearestWrongModel: atkPct 30.78 on allies — 'of the skill user's ATK' dropped. This is the classic caster-scaled misread and the single most damage-moving error available in this kit
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Ally-targeted buffApply events carry stat 'casterAtkPct' with a FLAT value ≈ 0.3078 × mari.staticAtk (≈30,277 at scope lock), NOT the raw 30.78 — assert on the emitted value per the harness's flat-resolution rule; red under the atkPct misread (value would be 30.78 under stat 'atkPct')
spec.inertness: The flat value must not scale with the RECIPIENT's ATK (same emitted value on the carry and on liter)

spec.kitLine: Deals 639.36% of final ATK as Burst Skill dmg
spec.scope: One instant flatDamage hit at 639.36% of mari's final ATK (buffed state at cast); burst-bucket flavored; no core (text does not say core strike); crit default-off unless measured
spec.triggerIdentity: burstCast (mari's OWN Burst II cast) — NOT fullBurstEnter
spec.targetSet: enemy (engine ignores target resolution; author target 'enemy')
spec.nearestWrongModel: Letting the hit take the +50% Full Burst major — burst-cast damage lands in the B2→B3→FB chain BEFORE the FB window opens, so it is FB-exempt by timing; a fullBurstEnter keying or a missing noFb both inflate it 1.5×
spec.distinguishingAssertion: The mari-srcSlot burst-bucket damage event fires between her burstCast event and the following fullBurstStart, with inFullBurst===false and fbMajorApplied===false; red if the event lands after fullBurstStart or with fbMajorApplied===true
spec.inertness: Fires exactly once per rotation MARI bursts; zero occurrences in a comp where she never casts (e.g. another B2 always takes the slot)

spec.scope: attackDamagePct — the Damage Up (additive, dilutable) bucket; NOT atkPct (ATK bucket) and NOT a multiplier bucket
spec.durationSemantics: durationSec: 10 — spans the ~10s FB window that follows her cast
spec.triggerIdentity: burstCast (a line inside her OWN burst block) — fires only on rotations mari actually casts; NOT fullBurstEnter (any team FB)
spec.nearestWrongModel: fullBurstEnter keying — coincides with burstCast in a solo-B2 comp (calibration hides it) but OVER-CREDITS the moment a second Burst II unit shares the team and casts instead of her; second-nearest: atkPct mis-bucketing (multiplies instead of diluting against other Damage-Up support)
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Every buffApply {stat:'attackDamagePct', value:40.99, casterIdx: mari's idx} is frame-coincident with a mari burstCast event and PRECEDES that rotation's fullBurstStart; in a two-B2 comp where the other B2 takes a rotation, that rotation has NO such apply — red under fullBurstEnter
spec.inertness: Zero applications on rotations mari did not cast; must not appear under stat 'atkPct'

notes: FIXTURE TRAP FIRST: mari is Burst II. controlComp(carry) fixes crown in the B2 slot and puts the carry at B3 — dropping mari in as 'carry' means she NEVER casts her burst and every burst-block assertion vacuously passes. Tests MUST build a comp with mari occupying the B2 slot (liter B1 / mari B2 / a real B3) so burstCast actually fires; assert at least one mari burstCast event exists as a fixture-sanity precondition. Expected shared-prior misreads to reconcile, in damage-moving order: (1) the ally ATK line as atkPct instead of casterAtkPct — 'of the skill user's ATK' is the whole line; assert on the FLAT emitted value (≈0.3078×98,367), which also catches it if the driver and override share the misread; (2) whole-fight hasPierce:true instead of a timed gainPierce(5s) on the skill2 trigger — inflates skill1's Pierce Damage ▲ uptime from ~5s/CD to 100%; (3) burst buff keyed fullBurstEnter — indistinguishable in a solo-B2 calibration comp, so the distinguishing test needs a two-B2 roster or the pre-FB frame-ordering assertion; (4) the burst nuke taking the +50% FB major. Two flags the driver must carry: the skill2 interval CD is ⚑ (not in kit prose — must cite datamined skillCooldownsSec, first fire t=CD per the no-activation-clause convention), and the SR cadence tuple is ALWAYS-⚑. One schema reconciliation: types.ts annotates pierceDamagePct 'parsed but inert in v1', but the gainPierce/hasPierce comments state Pierce Damage ▲ feeds Damage Up for pierce-tagged attackers — the tests must pin which is true in the live engine (if genuinely inert, skill1's pierce line and the pierce windows demote to GAP/engine, not silently to zero). Finally, note 'Affects all allies' conventionally includes self: mari should hold atkPct AND casterAtkPct simultaneously during skill2 windows — assert both stat keys land on her.
